components.name: Title block
components.description: Kicker, the one h1 and a lede. Once per document.

props.label: Lede
props.default: How the team plans, decides and hands work over. Read it once, then come back to the part you need.

components.name: Section
components.description: An h2 with a paragraph. Use h3 for a part of a section.

props.label: Text
props.default: Work is planned in cycles. Before a cycle starts, each person writes down what they expect to finish and what could get in the way.

components.name: List
components.description: A short bulleted list; three to six items.

props.label: First item
props.default: Pick only the few things each person can finish.

components.html:
• {{one}}
  • Name the person who decides if the scope has to change.
  • Leave one afternoon free for what nobody planned.

components.name: Table
components.description: Header row, hairlines, no zebra. Stacks into labelled rows under 560 px, so every td after the first needs data-label.

props.label: Text
